tasks.why_selected: Smallest paired task that directly pressures session-local cwd continuity and relative-path feedback.
Strongest current inspect/edit/write slice for measuring whether the rg-style search front door removes fallback retries.
Pressures narrow JSON query tooling under a fixed observation budget so the harness can measure fallback cost rather than only final correctness.

non_goals: Do not introduce host-shell drift into the paired baseline.
Do not widen the first paired task set beyond the narrow runtime-proof slice.
